erratum: Independent pre-run review found that pooled OOF AUROC can mix fold scales, whole-source bootstrap does not fix class mass, and Bangkok is post-hoc. No r7.68 model score had been observed. This contract makes source-class blocks and source-macro metrics authoritative and removes Bangkok from pass/fail.

head.type: single linear sigmoid marker-relation head with fixed zero-logit decision
head.target: continuous r7.55 future-route marker-hit fraction; active is fixed as target > 0
head.initialization: within each bootstrap, weighted active-minus-inactive unit prototype with midpoint bias
head.bootstrap: within each class independently sample complete source-class blocks with replacement; each class has 0.5 mass, each draw equal mass, each row within draw equal mass
head.standardization: bootstrap-only weighted mean and standard deviation, recomputed for every fold and seed

optimizer.loss: source-class-block-balanced soft-target binary cross entropy plus L2

evaluation.split: leave one complete source_id out before bootstrap
evaluation.authoritative_metrics: source-macro class recalls, their balanced mean, and median per-source AUROC over mixed-class held sources
evaluation.pooled_oof_auroc: diagnostic only because fold scales differ
evaluation.bangkok_role: same-source post-hoc side diagnostic only; never pass/fail
